summary: Pacific Booker Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a non-brokered private placement to raise up to $3,000,228 via 1,260,600 units at $2.38 per unit, each unit consisting of one common share and a warrant exercisable at $2.74 for 36 months. Proceeds will fund a new preliminary economic assessment for its Morrison project and general corporate purposes. The placement is subject to TSX Venture Exchange approval and customary conditions. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change is involved. The filing does not trigger any special-situations category.
